$comment: Copy to secrets/hud-accounts.json and fill in the real emails (secrets/ never enters git). `color` may name a slot of the active terminal scheme (brightCyan, purple, ... - resolved to its hex at install time), or be a literal #RRGGBB, or a classic ANSI name (cyan, magenta, ...). `slots` declares which account OWNS each config dir: the HUD chip turns red with `!` when a foreign credential shows up in an owned slot.
